title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Automatically enable Allow HttpClient Requests after custom extension/app installation
summary: This post explains how to automatically enable the Allow HttpClient Requests setting for custom extensions during installation using an install codeunit, avoiding the need for manual configuration in each environment.
key_points: Apps calling external services through HttpClient need Allow HttpClient Requests enabled in Extension Settings, per app including library apps
If the setting is off, calls can fail in the platform and users get a prompt asking whether to allow the request
Choosing Allow Always enables the option, but that has to happen manually in every environment
The setting lives in system table NAV App Setting, so an install codeunit can read the current module info and set the flag on install

quotes.text: It's therefore important that you check for this in your AL code.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the need to handle HttpClient request failures due to permission issues in extension development

quotes.text: This setting must be enabled for each app/extension, including library apps.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains why automatic enablement during installation is needed to avoid manual repetition across environments

quotes.text: This will automatically enable Allow HttpClient Requests after installation.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the practical solution using install codeunits to streamline extension deployment
